title: VLCC Spot Rates: Softer, but far from soft
section_path: VLCC Spot Rates: Softer, but far from soft
section_path_text: VLCC Spot Rates: Softer, but far from soft
summary:
Main
By Mary Melton
The VLCC market is softening, but we contend that the downside is limited. Exceptionally high freight costs have softened long-haul Atlantic-to-Asia demand. Asian refiners are increasingly favouring shorter-haul Middle East barrels offered either on a delivered basis or via ship-to-ship (STS) transfer in the Gulf of Oman.
